name: LinkMesh: Semantic AI Internal Links for SEO
author: aivc

sections.faq:
Does LinkMesh slow down my site?

No. This is the core design principle. Links are physically written into your post HTML at save time. There is zero runtime processing on page load – no database queries, no JavaScript injection, no DOM manipulation. Your TTFB and Core Web Vitals scores are completely unaffected.

Does it work with my page builder?

Yes. LinkMesh has native, deep integration with Gutenberg (React sidebar + AI toolbar button), Classic Editor, as well as Elementor (direct widget JSON traversal).

What happens if I deactivate LinkMesh?

Your links stay in your content. Period.

Is my content sent to external servers?

Yes, for AI processing only (embedding generation, semantic matching, anchor text generation). Data processing and text chunking happen entirely on the server side.

I already have links from other plugins and manually placed ones. What should I do?

No problem. Simply sync all your links via the Bulk Settings – Sync Manual Links tab.

Get 100 free AI credits and start building your semantic link graph today.
sections.description:
Automatically create smart internal links with AI anchor text. Rescue orphan pages, monitor 404s, and track clicks for maximum SEO impact.

10+ Internal Linking Tools in One Plugin – Powered by AI, Zero Impact on Page Speed

LinkMesh is a smart internal linking plugin that combines AI semantic search, orphan rescue, 404 monitoring, click analytics, internal PageRank, and much more. The plugin understands article context the same way a human does – it doesn’t just match letter by letter – and that’s exactly what Google values in ranking. LinkMesh saves hours of manual work: what used to take days now happens in just a few clicks.

100 free AI credits, no credit card required.

Problems LinkMesh Solves

  • Manual internal linking doesn’t scale. If your site has more than 20 pages, you’re leaving SEO value on the table.
  • Most linking plugins hurt performance. Runtime link injection adds 200-500 ms to TTFB – Google penalizes slow sites.
  • You need 4+ separate plugins just to cover link suggestions, orphan detection, 404 monitoring, click tracking, and authority scoring. Until today.

Why LinkMesh Is Different

Frozen Map: Zero Page Speed Impact

Every link is calculated and physically written into your post content the moment you hit “Save.” No JavaScript, no database queries at page load, no additional server load. Your page speed scores stay exactly where they are.

True AI That Understands Meaning

LinkMesh doesn’t just match keywords – it uses sentence-transformer embeddings and vector similarity search (pgvector) to find semantically related content. It understands that “car maintenance” and “vehicle service guide” are the same topic, even when they share no words.

Surgical Precision, Not Link Spam

A multi-layered guard system keeps your content clean:
– Skip Intro – protect your opening paragraph from links
– Min Gap – enforce minimum spacing between links
– Global Limit – cap total outbound links per post
– Target Limit – cap inbound links per page
– Excluded HTML Tags – prevent links in headings, code blocks, quotes
– Blacklist – exclude specific terms from ever becoming links
– Post Type Filter – choose exactly which content types get links

Native Gutenberg & Elementor Support

A full React-powered Gutenberg sidebar with an AI Link button right in your editing toolbar. Deep Elementor integration that traverses widget JSON to modify text-editor and heading – no hacks, no workarounds.

Full Feature Set

AI Smart Link Generator

The heart of LinkMesh. Your post content is analyzed by the semantic AI engine to find the most relevant connections across your entire site.

Bulk Settings (Link Control for Your Content)

Take full control over pages, categories, and even spacing between links.

Keyword Intelligence

Powerful n-gram analysis that finds link opportunities hidden in your existing content.

Orphan Rescue

Find and fix pages with zero inbound links – invisible to both users and search engines.

404 Scout

A background scanner that finds broken links before your visitors (or Google) do.

Click Analytics

Know exactly which links your visitors click and which they ignore.

AILM Rank (Internal PageRank)

Your own Google-style authority score for every page on your site.

Gutenberg Sidebar with AI Toolbar

A complete linking workflow without ever leaving the editor.

Review Queue

Quality control for AI-generated links at scale.

Automatic Reconciliation Engine

Content changes. Links drift. LinkMesh fixes it automatically.

CSV Export of Your Full Link Map

For those who love working with spreadsheets. Export, edit, re-import.

URL Migrator

SEO-safe migration of URLs when you change the permalink structure.

Who Is LinkMesh For?

  • SEO Agencies – manage internal linking across 100+ client sites. The Review Queue lets you quality-control every link before it goes live.
  • Content-Heavy Blogs – 500+ posts? Keyword Intelligence + AI Smart Links scale effortlessly where manual linking breaks down.
  • E-Commerce Stores – deep product interlinking with Skip Intro and Min Gap to keep product descriptions clean and readable.
  • News Sites – the Reconciliation Engine keeps links accurate as articles are updated throughout the day.
  • Anyone Who Cares About Page Speed – Frozen Map means zero runtime overhead. Your Core Web Vitals stay intact.

Compatibility

  • Gutenberg – full React-powered sidebar + AI button in the toolbar
  • Elementor – deep integration at the widget level (text-editor, heading)
  • Classic Editor – full support via the admin dashboard
  • All Modern WordPress Themes – DOM-based injection works with any theme

Roadmap

See the full roadmap:
https://linkmesh.co/documentation.html#roadmap

Q3 2026 (In Progress)

  • llms.txt & Markdown Endpoint
  • DONE! (Bulk URL Update on Site Restructure)

Q4 2026 (Planned)

  • Google Search Console Integration
  • Bing Webmaster Tools Integration
  • Yandex Metrica Integration

Getting Started in 4 Steps

  1. Install & Activate – the plugin auto-creates its database tables on activation.
  2. Get Your API Token – 100 free AI credits, no credit card required.
  3. Index Your Content – run post indexing and sync manually placed links.
  4. Generate Links – use the AI Smart Link modal, Gutenberg sidebar, or Keyword Intelligence mode.
